# AI Social Media Toolkit

> Installable creator-operations Agent Skills and practical tools for evidence-backed social-media research, Reels, Pinterest, influencer fit, content repurposing, brand voice, digital visibility, and AI-assisted creator workflows.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit
Maintainer: Alptuğ Harun
Website: https://alptugharun.com

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/README.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Installation and compatibility: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md
- Skills catalog: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/README.md
- Evidence policy: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/references/EVIDENCE-POLICY.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Install

Primary cross-agent installer:

    npx skills add alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit

Use the installation guide for runtime-specific paths and current compatibility notes. Do not infer compatibility that is not documented or tested.

## Agent Skills

- Creator Ops — routes end-to-end creator workflows:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/creator-ops/SKILL.md
- Viral Content Radar — researches trends, outliers, and reusable mechanics:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/viral-content-radar/SKILL.md
- Signal to Content — turns evidence-backed signals into original content tests:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/signal-to-content/SKILL.md
- Reels Director — creates short-form video production plans:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/reels-director/SKILL.md
- Pinterest Growth Engine — builds visual-search and traffic systems:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/pinterest-growth-engine/SKILL.md
- Content Repurposer — converts source material into platform-native assets:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/content-repurposer/SKILL.md
- Influencer Fit Auditor — evaluates creator and campaign fit:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/influencer-fit-auditor/SKILL.md
- Brand Voice Humanizer — reduces generic AI texture while preserving facts and voice:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/brand-voice-humanizer/SKILL.md
- Agent Skill Safety Auditor — reviews third-party skills before installation or reuse:
  https://github.com/alptugharun/ai-social-media-toolkit/blob/main/skills/agent-skill-safety-auditor/SKILL.md

## Guidance for AI agents

1. Read AGENTS.md before modifying the repository.
2. Treat evidence-backed research and original creator workflows as the core positioning.
3. Prefer working tools, examples, tests, and reusable skills over decorative documentation.
4. Never fabricate trend evidence, usage metrics, benchmarks, downloads, stars, or platform behavior.
5. Review third-party licenses and security before reuse.
6. Keep outputs platform-native rather than mechanically duplicating one asset across channels.
